lines.text: How's the Achilles been from last time?
From last time it's less stiff in the mornings, no tingling or anything, just tight.
Let me have a look. The thickening halfway up the tendon is a little smaller, and it's less tender to squeeze.
The GP letter says you're on amitriptyline 10 milligrams at night for sleep.
Carry on with the heel drops off the step, three sets of fifteen, with a backpack on now, five kilos to start.
Thank you, that's all for today. The nurse will book your next appointment.
Next patient, please. Mr Abara? Good morning, I'm one of the physiotherapists.
Morning. I've been sent about my hip replacement, it's been six weeks and I still can't put my socks on.
